label: nearmiss_hexagon_exact
notes: EXACT (coordinates in Q(sqrt3)) convex hexagon: two concentric equilateral triangles staggered by 60 deg, radii 1 and sqrt(3)-1.  Three of the six vertices see only 2 = floor(6/2)-1 distinct distances -- the counterexample budget -- and the other three see 3.  By the n=6 certification no hexagon can do better than this, so it is extremal.
